title: Qu'est ce que l'impulsion évolutive
text: all the most renowned and revered mystics from the world's great wisdom traditions all tell us the same thing they all boldly declare that the ultimate nature of reality is that there's only one and not two time space and the entire creative process emerged from primordial emptiness or nothingness how is it possible that energy and matter could emerge from primordial emptiness how could life emerge from energy and matter and finally how could mind emerge in life how did those quantum creative leaps of complexity actually occur from what we could call a process perspective from seeing the creative process as a whole we realize that the creative process is one process it's one event that's happening that's giving rise to all kinds of potentials and possibilities so the forms that the creative process give rise to come into being and eventually pass away but the impulse the creative impulse the evolutionary impulse that is giving rise to them is the singularity that is immortal and unchanging human beings experience the evolutionary impulse in the universe at three distinct levels so the first level is experience is the biological command to procreate or as a sexual impulse and the experience of the sexual impulse is the experience of an ecstatic urgency at a much higher level human beings experience that same evolutionary impulse as the uniquely human drive towards innovation human beings are the only life form on this planet that are compelled to innovate and give rise to that which is new the human species we seem to be driven and compelled to innovate and to create when a creative genius sees something that could exist but that does not exist yet and they are driven driven driven by an ecstatic sense of urgency to do whatever they need to do so that that which they see in the eye of their mind actually emerges in the world of time and space as a living reality at the highest level we experience the evolutionary impulse as the mysterious compulsion towards consciousness what does it mean to exist who am i why am i here why did something come from nothing that which compels human beings to come to terms existentially with the meaning and purpose of existence itself is none other than the same energy and intelligence that created the universe and is creating the universe it is not merely me andrew or any one of us as individuals who's merely couldn't go on in the same way unless some irreversible transformation actually occurred and i was driven i was i was driven driven driven by an ecstatic urgency to to attain a shift that was
